newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends down on correction.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed down on Tuesday on a correction following Monday's rises with selling mainly in shares expected to post poor 1996 results, brokers said.
The index edged down 0.698 points or 1.10 percent to 62.656 points, on volume of 17.1 million shares worth $8.3 million against $9.3 million on Monday.
Brokers said that Pudong shares and Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor, which are expected to give unpromising results for 1996, led the falls despite some institutional support.
Brokers said most investors had no interest in buying given the expectation of poor results for most firms on the market.
"Speculative buying pushed the index up in the previous two days, but most investors remain cautious due to concerns about comapny results," one broker said.
He said domestic investors were also busy with the re-registeration of B share trading accounts ordered by the securities authorities.
"The index fell below the key 63-point resistance level again, which will hurt market sentiment to some extent," a second broker said. "The index is likely to consolidate down in the next few days."
Of 43 B shares, 41 traded with 25 down, 11 flat and five up.
Sanmao Textile was the biggest loser on expectations of poor 1996 results, falling $0.014 or 6.25 percent to $0.210 on volume of 210,000 shares.
Tientsin Marine Shipping was the most active share on profit-taking, dipping $0.008 or 1.68 percent to $0.468 on volume of 2.3 million shares.
Blue chip Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor followed on heavy institutional selling with concerning about its results because of fierce competition, brokers said.
It fell $0.018 or 3.57 percent to $0.486 on volume of 1.7 million shares.
The Shanghai A share market reversed early gains on profit-taking selling with market sentiment cautious, brokers said.

The A index fell 4.157 points or 0.43 percent to 969.989 points on volume of 311.9 million shares worth 2.8 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index ended down 23.038 points or 0.91 percent to 2495.911 points.
Chengdu People Store was the biggest loser, falling 0.59 yuan or 4.50 percent to 12.51 yuan on volume of 847,400 shares.
